corruption.applied_to: outer test partition only; training partitions and fitted models stay clean
corruption.draws: one standard normal per gene per outer fold, shared by every model and fitting seed; each gene is multiplied by exp(sigma * draw)
corruption.expected: exact prediction invariance of rank-input models under every monotone transform

corruption_command: python -m experiments.make_revision.run_gene gene_corruption --output <run> --workers 16 (after a complete verified run; refits every outer model from its recorded selection and seed)

dataset_source.audit: experiments/make_revision/gene_data_audit.json: archive and member SHA-256, shape, class counts and dataset hash recorded on the first successful load; the loader refuses differing bytes
dataset_source.provider: UCI Machine Learning Repository id 401, gene expression cancer RNA-Seq (TCGA PANCAN HiSeq)

freeze_requirement: complete_model_registry_and_candidates_reviewed; attainable_training_only_pilot within the cap; leakage_checks_pass; freeze_before_outer_scores

gene_selection.historical_leakage: the exploratory 2025 script selected genes on all 801 samples before splitting; those numbers are exploratory only and not comparable
gene_selection.memo: the full gene ranking is a deterministic function of the training rows, labels and the fixed MI seed; it is memoised per process by partition content and optionally shared across worker processes through ARROWFLOW_GENE_MI_CACHE; a memo hit is identical to recomputation and never keyed by a held-out row
gene_selection.scope: fitted inside every training partition as the first pipeline step of every model family; n_genes is a tuned candidate axis of every family
gene_selection.tie_rule: descending mutual information, lowest gene index first; selected genes keep their MI order

af_full.adaptive_encoding: embed_dim/degree/augment resolved from the selected gene count and the training rows (bridge.resolve)
af_full.candidates: widths [128], learning_rate 0.1, embed_scale 1, degree_offset 0 x n_genes {10,15,20} = 3
af_full.method: bridge AdaptiveMultiView (7 diverse views, checkpoint 0.1, majority vote) on the selected raw expression values

af_native_ranks.candidates: widths [128], learning_rate 0.1, validation_ratio 0.1, iterations 200, batch_size 32, p_correct 0.01 x n_genes = 3
af_native_ranks.method: within-sample order of the selected genes fed directly as the permutation (ArrowFlowEstimator.fit_orders); embed_dim = n_genes

footrule_knn_ranks.candidates: n_neighbors {1,3,5,11,21} x weights {uniform,distance} x n_genes = 30, sampled to 24
footrule_knn_ranks.method: TopGenesByMI -> within-sample order -> StableFootruleKNN (Spearman footrule, source-row tie rule)

rf_ranked.candidates: the same 24 sampled configurations as rf_raw

rf_raw.candidates: comparisons.CONVENTIONAL_GRIDS random_forest x n_genes = 108, sampled to 24

svc_ranked.candidates: the same 24 sampled configurations as svc_raw
svc_ranked.method: TopGenesByMI -> within-sample ranks of the selected genes -> imputer -> StandardScaler -> SVC(rbf)

svc_raw.candidates: comparisons.CONVENTIONAL_GRIDS svc_rbf x n_genes = 48, sampled to 24 with the shared candidate seed

multiplicity: descriptive_secondary_benchmark; corruption intervals are descriptive without p-values
pilot: run_revision pilot (the gene registry clears its selector memo before every family so each family's first fit measures the selector), then run_gene pilot_projection --output <run>: the selector is charged once per (job, training partition) for every family that selects genes, and once per partition after the prepass; the harness pilot's own max-extrapolation is not the projection
resource_decision: training-only pilot at HEAD 1c1eb7fa4 projected 0.19 h at 16 workers after the selector prepass (0.39 h with the process memo only) against the 1 h cap; grid unchanged
selector_prepass: python -m experiments.make_revision.run_gene selector_prepass --output <run> --workers 16 after prepare and before run: ranks the genes of every training partition (outer and inner; 15 x 4 = 60) into <run>/mi_cache with per-partition keys/hashes in selector_prepass.json; export ARROWFLOW_GENE_MI_CACHE=<run>/mi_cache for run and gene_corruption. The factory still computes a missing partition itself and records selection_source=computed in its fit row; every fit row records the selected genes, ranking hash, cache key and source (representation_metadata)
status: drafted; training-only pilot, memo-aware projection within the cap, and freeze precede confirmatory scoring
